Socket display updates from the authoritative equipment state
Actual Enter removes a previously equipped fitil
Actual D-pad navigation follows the visible Arabic icon row
Distinct cost-two fitil is equipped through the same request path
Insufficient capacity explains refusal without emitting a mutation request
Capacity refusal is visible beside the selected description
A refusal keeps the selected cost and collection status visible
Refusal feedback does not push the footer out of the screen
Actual shoulder button changes to the inventory tab without leaving the seat
Inventory lists real abilities and the bought atlas, never an unowned needle
Language switch retains tab and selection with English descriptions
Actual D-pad reaches owned abilities below the first inventory row
Inventory scroll follows controller focus instead of hiding the selected item
Actual Tab returns to fitils without triggering journal or world actions

Menu cancel does not emit a stand request
